method.restricted_definition: first-print restricted event = ng2 revision event (v1->v2 index gap with full realtime windows, strict monotonicity fail-closed), usable in the S0 window, with first_print_in_realtime_era=True AND not a member of any bulk re-referencing group (>= 10 events sharing an identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) signature)
method.event_definition: per economy and reference month m: v1 = first vintage publishing m (earliest realtime_start with non-missing value), v2 = immediately following vintage; REVISION EVENT iff I_v2(m) != I_v1(m) with full available-time evidence (realtime windows on both vintages); ratio R = I_v2/I_v1 - 1 (ng2 section 4 frozen semantics, inherited via import)
method.usability: v2 availability day within the S0 window 2018-04-04..2025-04-30 (16:00-NY grid coverage); PIT at v2.realtime_start, date-only evidence -> conservative same-day bound in consumers
method.monotonicity: v2.realtime > v1.realtime STRICT (fail-closed); byte-identical duplicate vintage rows are deduplicated first (disclosed ingest artifact; conflicting same-day rows still raise)
method.bulk_re_referencing_law: identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) across >= 10 months = one bulk re-referencing transition excluded from the first-print stream (ng2 census disclosure law, frozen)
method.restricted_differential_join: CA-anchored: an obs month counts iff CA carries a restricted event AND >= 1 other economy (GB/AU/NZ/US non-anchor legs) carries a restricted event in the same obs month; quarter-first month keys for AU/NZ (ng2 join law); months with multi-economy overlap but no CA event are disclosed, never counted

monotonicity_check.law: v2.realtime > v1.realtime STRICT per month; a single violation raises VintageMonotonicityError and NO events are built (fail-closed; ng2 law inherited verbatim via build_restricted_stream)
monotonicity_check.dedupe_law: byte-identical duplicate rows only (same obs_date + realtime window + value: ingest artifact, zero ambiguity); conflicting same-realtime_start rows still raise fail-closed (a genuine same-day correction makes the month unmeasurable, never guessed)

positive control: a measured CA event month (taken from the built events) must be found
